network_domain_allowlist.justification: Atlassian-controlled domains (.atlassian.net primary, .atl-paas.net PaaS, .atlassian.com corporate, .atlassian-dev.net CDN) plus required third-party services: .cloudfront.net (AWS CDN), .gravatar.com + .wp.com (user avatars), .ingest.sentry.io (error tracking). Fail-closed if other domains contacted.
